summary: This bill allows the Secretary of the Interior to lease mineral deposits within the City of Carlsbad, New Mexico, on federal or acquired lands, overriding existing prohibitions, provided the City of Carlsbad gives written consent.

scores.thoughts: This bill allows for the leasing of mineral deposits within Carlsbad, New Mexico, which could lead to increased mineral extraction. While not directly about environmental regulations, increased extraction activities generally have environmental impacts, making this tangentially related to less environmental protection.
